title: payment.refunded payload v1
description: A Stripe refund. Amounts in cents. id is the refund (re_...) when the booker had the refund object, else the Stripe event id (evt_...) of the charge.refunded that reported it.

charge.description: The Stripe charge (ch_...) that was refunded. With payment_intent, how a refund event whose id is a Stripe event id (evt_...) is tied to Stripe's refund objects.

payment_intent.description: The Stripe payment intent (pi_...) of the refunded charge, when it has one.

invoice.description: The invoice (in_...) the refunded payment paid.

booking.description: The caller's booking id, when the refunded payment was a booking's (no invoice).

amount_refunded.description: The charge's total refunded so far (cents), after this refund; amount is what this event added to it.
